name: PNB RuPay Antah Drishthi Braille Debit Card
description: RuPay PNB Antah Drishti Braille Debit Card is a RuPay PNB ANTAH DRISHTI Braille Debit Card from Punjab National Bank. Domestic usage; ATM limit Rs. 25,000/day, PoS/eCom limit Rs. 60,000/day. NCMC offline transit enabled. Valid 7 years.
tagline: RuPay Classic debit card from PNB — domestic usage with NCMC transit.
features: Can be used at all POS terminals, E Com Websites / Apps and ATMs across India
Raised Braille Dots (PNB in Braille) - The “PNB” is prominently embossed on the card, making it easy for visually impaired and blind customers to differentiate between PNB and other Banks` Cards
Rounded Notch – The card has a rounded notch on the opposite side of the chip

This facilitates the card holder to know about the direction of the card while dipping the same in ATM / POS. Glossy Spot UV lamination effect – The card have a glossy spot UV lamination effect with raised texture on the Bank`s logo and silk screen rough spot UV on the contactless symbol
This helps visually impaired and blind customers to locate the bank`s logo easily and read the card`s contactless symbol, making it easy for them to use the card

Contrasting colours – The card have contrasting colours for easier reading and the colours used on the card are easily distinguishable by visually impaired and blind customers, making it easy for them to read the card details

Rupay National Common Mobility Card (NCMC) The RuPay National Common Mobility Card (NCMC) is a contactless payment solution designed to facilitate seamless transactions across transport, retail, and parking
Launched with the vision of “One Nation One Card,” this card aims to integrate multiple payment needs into a single card, promoting convenience and efficiency for users
RuPay NCMC is part of India`s initiative to create a unified and interoperable payment system

notes: Individual Saving / Current account Customers who are Visually Impaired and Blind persons.Branches to ensure to update the status of all such customers to ‘BLIND’ in CRM.
